usedFor: TallyPrime holds accounting vouchers, and Freshsales Classic updates a deal through “Update Deal” when one is recorded.

bestTemplate.name: “New Receipt event occurs” in TallyPrime, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A recorded receipt can move a deal forward, such as changing its stage.

watchOut: “New Receipt event occurs” also runs when a receipt is updated or deleted, so “Update Deal” can run again.
